title: Your Insurance Policy: Now, Who Really Sold It To You?
description: India's insurance regulator, IRDAI, is proposing big changes to how insurance is sold. Every insurance policy might soon be digitally linked to the specific s.

faq.q: Will I get a digital receipt with the salesperson's name on it?
faq.a: The exact format is still in proposal, but the intent is to digitally link each policy to the salesperson, making their involvement traceable for accountability.

faq.q: What if my agent leaves the company?
faq.a: The proposal for "lifelong registrations" (with annual fees) aims to ensure continuity of service. Even if an individual agent changes roles, the system is designed for ongoing accountability and service stability.

faq.q: Are these rules only for life insurance?
faq.a: The proposals are part of a sweeping overhaul of insurance regulations, implying they will cover various types of insurance, including life, health, and general insurance, where sales practices are relevant.

faq.q: What if I bought my policy online without an agent?
faq.a: These rules primarily address sales made through individual agents and corporate agents (like banks). Online direct purchases usually have different disclosure and grievance mechanisms already in place.
